title: The Returning Exiles

questions.question: Why were the people of Judah taken into exile to Babylon?
options: Because of their unfaithfulness (breach of faith)
Because they were defeated in battle
questions.correctAnswer: Because of their unfaithfulness (breach of faith)
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:1 (ESV): "...And Judah was taken into exile in Babylon because of their breach of faith."

questions.question: Who were the first to dwell again in their possessions in their cities?
options: Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants
questions.correctAnswer: Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:2 (ESV): "Now the first to dwell again in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants."

questions.question: Which tribes lived in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:3 (ESV): "And some of the people of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem."

questions.question: What was the duty of the gatekeepers?
options: To guard the threshold of the tent/house of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: To guard the threshold of the tent/house of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:19 (ESV): "...were in charge of the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent..."

questions.question: Who was the ruler of the house of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:11 (ESV): "and Azariah the son of Hilkiah... the chief officer of the house of God;"

questions.question: Who was over the gatekeepers in time past?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:20 (ESV): "And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the chief officer over them in time past..."

questions.question: How many gatekeepers were chosen?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:22 (ESV): "All these, who were chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds, were 212."

questions.question: Who ordained the gatekeepers in their positions of trust?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:22 (ESV): "...whom David and Samuel the seer established in their office of trust."

questions.question: What were the four chief gatekeepers in charge of?
options: The chambers and the treasures of the house of God
questions.correctAnswer: The chambers and the treasures of the house of God
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:26 (ESV): "...were in charge of the chambers and the treasures of the house of God."

questions.question: What was Mattithiah responsible for?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:31 (ESV): "...had the duty of making the flat cakes."

questions.question: Who was the father of Zichri?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:15 (ESV): "...and Zichri the son of Asaph."

questions.question: How often were the showbread rows arranged?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:32 (ESV): "...it was their duty to prepare it for every Sabbath."

questions.question: Who lived free from other duties in the chambers of the temple?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:33 (ESV): "Now these, the singers... lived in the chambers of the temple free from other duties..."

questions.question: Where did the father of Gibeon live?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 9:35 (ESV): "In Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel..."

key_verse_text: So all Israel was enrolled by genealogies; and these are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was taken into exile in Babylon because of their breach of faith.
